definitions: A tax levied on secondary residences, often those used as temporary or occasional dwellings, particularly in urban areas.
A specific type of property tax targeting non-primary residences, especially luxury apartments or homes, often owned by non-residents or for investment purposes.
examples: New York City considered implementing a pied-à-terre tax.
The debate over the pied-à-terre tax intensified.
Advocates supported the pied-à-terre tax to fund public services.
